title: Document export-and-commit before fetch or merge in the task-sync workflow
outcome: Document export-and-commit before fetch or merge in the task-sync workflow
acceptance: The task-sync usage skill tells operators to export and commit local planning before fetching or merging the data branch and not to make a planning edit between a merge and its import
The existing divergent-planning set-aside remedy remains linked for a merge performed with an unexported local edit
No production code, watcher, global lock or new gate is added
